name: metapathfinder
description: Cognitive state tracking and adaptive learning system

scripts.install-all: npm install && cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install && cd ..
scripts.start-all: npm run install-all && npm run dev
scripts.dev: concurrently --names "express,frontend,python" --prefix-colors "yellow,cyan,green" "cd backend && npm run dev" "cd frontend && npm run dev" "cd backend-python && .venv\Scripts\python.exe run.py"
